# Third-Party Extracted Sources

This directory contains third-party source used by the kernel corpus cases.

- `hip-stream-k/` contains the headers and timing helper extracted from
  `ROCm/hip-stream-k`. See `hip-stream-k/NOTICE.md` and the case manifests
  under `../cases/hip-stream-k/`.
- `hip-matmul/` contains HIP matmul and matvec testbed sources extracted from
  `nod-ai/hip-matmul`. See `hip-matmul/NOTICE.md`, `hip-matmul/LICENSE`, and
  the case manifests under `../cases/hip-matmul/`.
- `hipkittens/` contains HipKittens include files and selected GEMM sources
  extracted from `HazyResearch/HipKittens`. See
  `hipkittens/NOTICE.md`, `hipkittens/LICENSE`, and the case manifests under
  `../cases/hipkittens/`.
